title: Rivals Confrontation
next_chapter_hook: Before Mo Xiansheng could finish speaking, the void suddenly tore open a pitch-black rift, and a Heavenly Dao pressure that could suffocate even a Transcendent Deity realm cultivator poured out—the Eye of Heavenly Dao had already noticed the anomaly here.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to respond, an ancient and authoritative aura suddenly descended. Ling Yuan's figure slowly emerged from the shadows, those turbid old eyes interweaving with indescribably complex emotions. The teleportation array light at the secret realm's exit flickered uncertainly behind him, as if it would devour this space at any moment. "Chen Ji..." The old man's voice was hoarse and low, carrying an inexplicable sigh, "Do you know how many years this old man has waited for this moment?"

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his fingers secretly clutched the Tianji Record Fragment within his sleeve. He could sense the profound and unfathomable aura emanating from Ling Yuan—an oppressive might far beyond the Transcendent Deity realm, as deep as an abyss and vast as an ocean, as if a single thought could crush the entire secret realm. Yet Chen Ji's heart was utterly calm and serene. He had foreseen this moment a quarter-hour earlier. The moment Ling Yuan stepped into the secret realm, he had already laid out three contingencies. "Senior Ling Yuan visits so late at night—may I ask your purpose?" Chen Ji's voice was gentle to the point of almost being humble, "If you have come for the secret realm's treasures, the junior can..."

dialogue.content: "Treasures?" Ling Yuan suddenly laughed, the laughter old and hoarse, like withered wood grinding in the cold wind. "You think what this old man wants are those trashy treasures and spiritual materials?" He stepped forward, and the spiritual energy between heaven and earth suddenly stagnated. "Chen Ji, that thing on your body... it never belonged to you."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart skipped half a beat, but his expression remained unmoved. He slowly raised his head, and a hint of bewilderment flickered across those usually docile eyes: "What thing the Senior mentions, the junior truly does not know..." Before he could finish, a bone-chilling killing intent pressed down on his shoulders like a physical force. Chen Ji's knees bent slightly, and the blue stone floor beneath his knees actually cracked finely under this pressure. The pain pierced his bones, but Chen Ji gritted his teeth and forcibly swallowed the blood rising in his throat. The waste persona must not break. "The junior... truly does not know."

dialogue.content: "Tianji Record." Ling Yuan spoke each word deliberately, and those turbid old eyes actually burst forth with dazzling brilliance at this moment. "That ancient supreme treasure, the scroll fragment that Chen Xuan protected with his life... it chose you?" The old man's voice suddenly rose sharply, nearly ear-piercing. "By what right?! By what right is it you, this waste! It should have been mine! It should have been mine, Ling Yuan's!"

text.content: The pressure was like a mountain, but Chen Ji's spine slowly straightened at this moment. He looked at this nearly insane old man, his mind racing rapidly. The Tianji Record chose me? This was fresh information. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned that the Tianji Record had other candidates, and this Ling Yuan... why was he so obsessed with the Tianji Record? More importantly, he said "it should have been mine"—what did that mean? Chen Ji's brain whirred like a precise abacus, while maintaining that terrified and bewildered expression. "Senior Ling Yuan... what connection do you have with the Tianji Record?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's laughter stopped abruptly. An expression that was unclear whether it was mockery or desolation appeared on that aged face: "Connection? Do you know that the blood flowing in this old man's body is also from the Chen family?" He violently tore open his robe, revealing a ferocious brand on his chest—a crossed-out "Chen" character. "Thirty-seven years ago, this old man was also one of the Chen family's bloodline candidates. But simply because my mother was an concubine, I was expelled from the family registry! The Tianji Record... it should have chosen me on that day!"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted. Concubine-born bloodline, expelled from the family registry, Chen family candidate... this information flashed through his mind like lightning, suddenly illuminating the previously vague chess game. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said—"The Tianji Record chooses people, never following common sense." So that was it. It passed over Ling Yuan and chose Chen Ji, who was just an infant at the time? There must be profound meaning in this. An inexplicable chill surged through Chen Ji's heart, mixed with a certain comprehension. Being chosen by the Tianji Record was indeed not that simple. "So..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, he tried to make this trembling sound like fear, "Senior Ling Yuan came here tonight to take back what should belong to you?"

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's question came like a blade, and Chen Ji felt that oppressive might beyond the Transcendent Deity realm strengthening step by step. He had to make a choice:

choices.description: Stop pretending, use the Tianji Record Fragment's power to probe Ling Yuan's true strength, seeking weaknesses. Extremely high risk, but may obtain critical information.
choices.visible_reward: Probe Ling Yuan's partial trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's strength far exceeds imagination, may expose all trump cards

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly changed. That weakness and terror were like a mask being torn off, revealing the cold and sharp edge beneath. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve suddenly emitted a ghostly blue glow, and a strand of foresight power instantly flooded his mind—in three breaths, Ling Yuan's left hand would reach for his throat. Enough. "Senior Ling Yuan," Chen Ji's voice suddenly became indifferent and composed, "Are you certain you wish to make a move here?"

choices.description: Probe Ling Yuan's true attitude using the Chen family bloodline identity, guiding him to reveal more hidden information. Relatively safe, can obtain more intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: May expose that you know more information
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues about Ling Yuan's past
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may see through the disguise, making the situation more dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered subtly, then a complex expression appeared. He slowly lowered his head, his voice carrying a hint of difficulty: "So... Senior Ling Yuan is also Chen family bloodline." He raised his head, and a trace of imperceptible resonance actually welled up in those eyes. "All these years, the junior... has not had an easy time in the Chen family. If I had known earlier that Senior Ling Yuan shared the same clan with the junior, perhaps..." He didn't finish, but the implication was already clear enough.

choices.description: Directly inquire about the true relationship between the Tianji Record and Ling Yuan, probe Mo Xiansheng's stance. Most safe, but may appear too eager.
choices.visible_cost: May expose insufficient understanding of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Serves as the opportunity for Mo Xiansheng's appearance
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may be unwilling to reveal more

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then spoke softly: "Sect Leader Ling, there is something this junior does not understand." His voice was calm to the point of eeriness. "Since the Tianji Record has chosen this junior, if you kill me tonight, will it simply choose you again?" Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply, and that imposing pressure flickered for an instant. Chen Ji caught it keenly—this question had touched Ling Yuan's true weakness.

Ling Yuan's face contorted grotesquely at this moment. He stared at Chen Ji's eyes, calm to the point of eeriness, then suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly: "Good! Good! Good!" The laughter brimmed with madness and desolation. "No wonder Chen Xuan chose you—you do have some cunning!" His right hand rose abruptly, and jet-black spiritual energy surged from his palm, forming a sky-obscuring giant hand. "You think this old man has no backup? Tonight, you will surely die!"

Chen Ji felt the surrounding space suddenly solidify, a terrifying force sufficient to crush a cultivator at the Hua Shen realm pressing down upon him. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve vibrated intensely, as if issuing a warning. Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his heart: this strike from Ling Yuan carried at least the power of early Tribulation Transcendence. If he met it head-on with his current strength, he would surely be crushed to dust. But if he counterattacked using the Tianji Record's foresight... He gritted his teeth, about to activate the fragment's power, when an aged yet familiar voice sounded in this critical moment—"Enough."

dialogue.content: The Void tore apart, and a illusory figure slowly walked out from the rift. It was an elderly man in gray robes, his features ancient yet commanding, surrounded by a faint golden glow. His appearance was like a scorching sun suddenly rising, completely crushing Ling Yuan's sky-obscuring oppressive pressure. "Mo Xiansheng!" Chen Ji blurted out, his heart churning like massive waves—he had never summoned Mo Xiansheng, so why would he appear on his own? Ling Yuan's expression became extraordinarily interesting at this moment, that manic aura replaced by a sudden astonishment: "You're... still alive?!"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's illusory form drifted gracefully between Chen Ji and Ling Yuan. Those ancient, unruffled eyes first glanced at Chen Ji, then turned to Ling Yuan, before finally letting out a long sigh: "Ling Yuan. Thirty-seven years." His voice carried an indescribable emotion. "You are still obsessed." Ling Yuan's face twisted violently; an almost savage expression appeared on that aged visage. "Obsessed? This old man was expelled from the Chen family, abandoned by the Tianji Record, trampled by fate... Wasn't it you who caused all of this?!"

dialogue.content: "Ling Yuan." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned low and serious. "Do you know what relationship exists between you and Chen Ji?" Ling Yuan froze momentarily, then coldly smiled: "What relationship? He's merely a worthless fool with rotten luck, while I am a pitiful person abandoned by fate—""No." Mo Xiansheng interrupted him. "You are Chen Ji's distant cousin. Your great-grandfathers were brothers." These words struck like thunder, exploding in the silent secret realm.

text.content: Chen Ji's body stiffened slightly. Although he had guessed a portion from Ling Yuan's casual remarks, hearing the true answer still stirred an ineffable wave within his heart. A distant cousin... fratricide among kin? His gaze involuntarily fell upon the erased "Chen" character on Ling Yuan's chest, suddenly perceiving another layer of meaning behind that mark—not merely the shame of being expelled from the family register, but a bone-deep longing and unwillingness. "So..." Chen Ji spoke softly. "Everything Sect Leader Ling has done in these thirty-seven years was to prove himself to the Chen family?"

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng had revealed this shocking truth, and the scene fell into an eerie silence. Ling Yuan's expression flickered between shadow and light; Chen Ji felt the heavy turning of destiny's gears. At this moment, he needed to make a choice:

choices.text: Take the initiative to show goodwill
choices.description: Attempt to resolve the grudge through blood ties, proposing to work with Ling Yuan against a greater enemy together. Demonstrating magnanimity may turn an enemy into a friend, but could also be misinterpreted as weakness.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's obsession runs too deep; he may not be easily swayed

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and bowed deeply to Ling Yuan: "Since we share the same bloodline, this junior is willing to bear full responsibility for all past misunderstandings. If Sect Leader Ling does not嫌弃, Chen Ji wishes to prioritize our blood kinship and pursue great endeavors together." Ling Yuan's eyes trembled slightly, that manic aura flickering for an instant. But the next moment, his expression suddenly turned gloomy: "Blood kinship? Hah! This old man doesn't need your charity!"

choices.description: Do not take the initiative to express stance; quietly observe and let Mo Xiansheng continue to reveal more information. Conservative and steady; may obtain more truth.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to resolve the conflict
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the Tianji Record's plan
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may think Chen Ji is watching and waiting, becoming even more furious

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, his expression as calm as still water in an ancient well. He did not speak, merely directing his gaze toward Mo Xiansheng, waiting for the other party to continue. Mo Xiansheng seemed quite satisfied with his reaction; his illusory form slightly nodded: "Chen Ji, you are more composed than this old man anticipated." He turned to Ling Yuan. "Ling Yuan, do you know why the Tianji Record did not choose you?"

choices.description: Directly question why Mo Xiansheng concealed Ling Yuan's existence, demanding the other party explain the true criteria for the Tianji Record's selection. Showing sharpness may obtain core information.
choices.visible_reward: "Extract the crucial information of the Tianji Record plan"
choices.risk_hint: "Master Mo might therefore reduce his assistance to Chen Ji"

text.content: "Master Mo." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a trace of subtle sharpness. "You always said the Tianji Record chooses people with profound intentions. Then why did it skip Ling Yuan and choose me? Why have you never mentioned his existence?" Master Mo's movements paused slightly, and a complex expression flickered across those deep, still eyes. After a moment, he slowly replied: "Because... both of you are part of the Tianji Record plan."

Master Mo's words struck like a heavy hammer against Chen Ji and Ling Yuan's hearts. The Tianji Record plan—these four characters hung in the air like an ancient prophecy, carrying an oppressive weight that stole one's breath. Chen Ji's heart rate surged; he stared intently at Master Mo's illusory face, his voice tightening slightly: "The Tianji Record plan... what does it mean?" Master Mo did not answer directly but slowly turned to face that pitch-black Void. His back appeared infinitely ancient at this moment, as if bearing secrets spanning countless millennia. "Chen Ji, do you think the Tianji Record chose you because of your exceptional talent?" Master Mo's voice carried an indescribable nuance. "No. It chose you because... you must die."

These words splashed over him like a basin of ice water, freezing Chen Ji's thoughts completely. Must die? The Tianji Record selected him so he could die? Countless images flashed through his mind—the moment he used the Tianji Record to foresee the future, precious Heavenly Fate was consumed each time; when Heavenly Fate was exhausted, that was when the prophet would fall. Master Mo had told him this long ago... Could it be that from the very beginning, the Tianji Record was a machine that devoured its users' lifespans? Chen Ji's palms exuded cold sweat, yet his expression remained as calm as ever. He gazed at Master Mo's back, his voice low and steady: "So... Ling Patriarch, is also part of this plan?" Master Mo did not turn around, merely nodding gently. "Both of you are its chess pieces."

Ling Yuan's body trembled violently; an expression of near-collapse appeared on that aged face. "Chess pieces... chess pieces..." he murmured, repeating these words, then suddenly burst into laughter toward the heavens. "Good! Good indeed, Tianji Record! So all my life, I was merely walking upon its chessboard!" The laughter was mournful and insane, echoing through the spacious secret realm. Chen Ji watched this scene quietly, while his mind raced with calculations. Master Mo revealing this truth now must have profound meaning. Was he friend or foe? What was the true purpose of the Tianji Record plan? More importantly—could Chen Nian's whereabouts also be related to this plan? Just as his thoughts swirled, Master Mo's voice sounded again, carrying an unprecedented gravity: "But both of you... still have room to choose."

dialogue.content: Master Mo turned around; those deep, still eyes actually flickered with an unusual light. He glanced at Chen Ji, then at Ling Yuan, before letting out a long sigh: "The Tianji Record plan began one thousand years ago, with a wager between the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and the Tianji Record." His voice was low and slow, each word seeming to carry the weight of a thousand jun. "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets wished to prove that destiny can be controlled by humans; the Tianji Record wished to prove that destiny cannot be completely divined. Both of you... are pieces in this gamble." He paused. "But the outcome of chess pieces does not necessarily have only one possibility—being discarded."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart skipped half a beat. A wager between the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and the Tianji Record? One thousand years? Fragments of information he had gathered before raced through his mind—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was the ultimate antagonist, and the Tianji Record was one of its pieces scattered across the world. But now Master Mo claimed there was actually a wager between the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and the Tianji Record? His mind functioned like a precision machine, rapidly piecing together these fragments. "Master Mo." Chen Ji spoke, his voice eerily calm. "Are you saying... the Tianji Record is not a piece of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, but its opponent?" Master Mo smiled faintly, that smile carrying a thread of relief: "You are much smarter than this master anticipated."

Just as Chen Ji wished to press for more details, the Void suddenly trembled violently. A terrifying pressure that surpassed everything, capable of collapsing the entire secret realm, poured down from the celestial vault above, even causing Master Mo's illusory form to sway unsteadily. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—this pressure, he had vaguely sensed in some divination before, yet had never imagined actually encountering. "This is..." His voice trembled slightly, the first time he displayed genuine emotion before this old man. Master Mo's expression became unprecedentedly grave: "It has come." Ling Yuan's face turned ashen in an instant; that dominant, insane aura from just moments ago vanished without a trace. "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets... how could it..." Master Mo's voice rang like a great bell throughout the space: "Chen Ji, your battle with Ling Yuan has alarmed it!"

Before Master Mo's words even finished, the Void suddenly tore open a jet-black fissure. A Heavenly Dao pressure sufficient to suffocate Transcendent realm cultivators poured out—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets had noticed the anomaly here. Within that fissure's depths, it seemed as if some ancient and terrifying existence was slowly awakening; a pair of无形却能洞穿万物的眼眸，正透过这裂隙注视着他们。陈机的脑海中警铃大作，天机录残页在他袖中疯狂震颤
